selection_rule: non-merge commits since --since, oldest first, touching between 3 and 12 text files, with at least one modified non-test source file (.go|.ts|.tsx|.swift|.py) and at least one test-or-spec file (_test.go, *.test.ts, *.test.tsx, *Tests.swift, _test.py, docs/specs/**); the presented patch is the source-file hunks alone, at most 64 KiB, over which `cem begin` parses between 3 and 20 hunks; a change is rejected when any source hunk contains a gold path literal; select index floor(i*N/n) for i in 0..n-1 over the candidates in commit order
